title: saxifraga lingulata subsp. lantoscana
intro: Saxifraga lingulata subsp. lantoscana, commonly known as Alpine Saxifrage, is a plant species within the Saxifragaceae family, known for its unique appearance and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Alpine Saxifrage include its potential to treat digestive issues and reduce inflammation, making it a valuable addition to traditional medicine. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in modern herbalism.
